slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A polygon is a closed figure made of segments, its sides, that meet only at their endpoints. Polygons are named by their number of sides: triangle (3), quadrilateral (4), pentagon (5), hexagon (6), octagon (8). A polyhedron is a solid whose faces are polygons.

The Sierpinski triangle repeats one rule: join the midpoints of each triangle's sides and remove the middle triangle. At stage n there are 3n shaded triangles, each side half as long as the stage before, so the shaded area is (3/4)n of the original.

slides.reveal: 3 cubed = 27 triangles, and (3/4) cubed = 27/64 of the area.
